scope: Feasibility only: remote-drive preparation, observation, probe and future continue the same physical state in the same apparatus. No posterior inference, Gaussian rendering, real-camera validation or novelty claim.
protocol: Freeze these illustrative parameters before running; they are not calibrated material or hardware measurements.
Always start from virgin state, prepare with remote drive only, unload and rest. Never overwrite gap, velocity or maximum opening to make a target match.
Nominal preparation commands may fail to reach their intended local history. Record the actual state and the miss explicitly, including the soft-fixture negative control.
Continue weak/probe/future cycles without resetting material history or clock. Passive and probed branches clone the same post-weak state.
Separate same-material history effects from joint material/history ambiguity. Monotonic separation displacement for the stable single-interface law is not a history-specific target.
Camera precision tables propagate assumed pixel error and systematic floor; they are not measured accuracy or hardware recommendations.
